--- judge_2 (qwen/qwen3.5-122b-a10b, JRS=0.317) ---
The proof is mathematically rigorous and correct. It properly establishes the convergence of Minibatch SGD with a fixed stepsize under nonconvex smoothness assumptions. The derivation correctly applies the L-smoothness lemma (Lemma 1) and the variance decomposition (Lemma 2). All assumptions (Smoothness, Unbiasedness/Bounded Variance, Lower Boundedness, Step size range) are explicitly stated and correctly utilized in the derivation steps [Step 9] through [Step 17]. The algebraic manipulations, particularly the handling of the cross-term and the variance bound, are accurate. The final bound correctly reflects the trade-off between the optimization error (decaying as 1/T) and the noise floor (proportional to stepsize/variance). The dry run example and special cases (deterministic, PL condition) are also correctly derived.
